children: Happiest Minds Technologies, an AI and IT services provider, agreed to merge with ITC Infotech India.
The combined company is expected to generate $1 billion in annual sales by fiscal 2028 and serve 800 customers with operations in more than 30 countries.

ITC Infotech will acquire an aggregate minority stake of 22.1% in Happiest Minds across two tranches for a total consideration of 13.3 billion Indian rupees, which is equal to roughly $140.1 million. The average share price is 395 rupees, or $4.16, a share.
ITC Limited will be the promoter of the merged company with a 73.4% stake.
The proposed merger will be effected through a share swap, where Happiest Mind shareholders will receive 25 shares of ITC Infotech for every 81 of their shares.
The deal is expected to be completed over the next 15 months, pending approval from stock exchanges and regulators. The companies will continue to operate independently until receiving the approvals.
